summary: Jiayin Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a leadership change: Ms. Dan Qi appointed Chief Risk Officer effective June 1, 2026, replacing Ms. Yifang Xu who resigned for personal reasons. No deal terms (price, premium, stake) apply. The board expresses gratitude to Xu and support for Qi. This is a routine executive succession, not a forced/abrupt departure triggering a special situation. The filing is a foreign private issuer report mapping to a U.S. current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; monitor for any subsequent material changes.
